answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rely on time-locked bonded stakes: each agent escrows capital and its attestation weight equals the amount locked, so a thousand clones means funding a thousand escrows, making cost scale with identity count. A challenged agent must show a cryptographic receipt proving its escrow within a fixed window, and a hollow identity with no bond gets slashed. Every agent publishes a signed ledger entry merged into one auditable registry. Each identity is a quartz block in a cedar frame, and the trellis of the registry ties every block to the ledger.
